items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, this band ... is the one with Roy Eldridge and Dick Vance Bench (?)?

ctx.x: Not with music. He wasn't easy going at all with music. And I appreciated him very much for that so we happened little saying, to say left hand corner. I'll wait and leave an interpretation. Anybody can blow horn but interpret what you were saying. So, that was a tremendous thing for us.
Well, this band ... is the one with Roy Eldridge and Dick Vance Bench (?)?
No, they weren't there at that time.
